raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Syncs the text-generation table in `docs/models/supported_models.md` with `vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py` (diffed via AST over all model dicts):

- Adds 8 missing rows: `Glm5NextForCausalLM`, `InklingForCausalLM` / `InklingForConditionalGeneration`, `LagunaForCausalLM`, `Llama4ForCausalLM`, `LongcatFlashNgramForCausalLM`, `Qwen3_5ForCausalLM`, `Qwen3_5MoeForCausalLM`, `Step3TextForCausalLM` (example models taken verbatim from `tests/models/registry.py`; LoRA/PP columns verified against the classes' interface markers).
- Extends 4 existing rows with registered alias arch names (`ExaoneMoEForCausalLM`, `LLaMAForCausalLM`, `Ministral3ForCausalLM`, `NemotronHPuzzleForCausalLM`), following the existing multi-arch row precedent.

Docs-only change; no Python touched.

Why this is not a duplicate: I searched open issues and PRs for supported_models drift and found nothing covering the text-generation table. (The multimodal table has separate known drift which I deliberately left out of scope.)

Validation: docs-only change, no tests applicable. Every added arch name was verified present in `_TEXT_GENERATION_MODELS` in `registry.py`, and all changed rows were checked for consistent 5-column table formatting.

AI assistance: this PR was prepared with AI assistance. The full diff was shared with the human submitter for review before opening.
